findings.symptom: Browsers report 'Network Error' / 'Failed to fetch' on any authenticated or tenant-scoped API request.
findings.rootCause: Backend corsOptions.allowedHeaders omitted 'X-Dairy-Id', 'x-dairy-id', 'X-Client-App', 'X-Client-Version', and 'X-Device-Id'. Browser preflight OPTIONS requests were rejected with HTTP 403 / CORS policy violation, immediately cancelling the actual request before hitting Express routes.
findings.remediation: Added all required tenant and client custom headers to corsOptions.allowedHeaders in cors.ts.

findings.symptom: Mobile application failed to connect to backend on local Wi-Fi LAN with AxiosError: Network Error.
findings.rootCause: Hardcoded stale IP 10.114.224.223 in .env and api-client.ts fallback. Host development machine Wi-Fi network interface had transitioned to 10.136.173.223. Stale IP had precedence over dynamic Metro bundler hostUri.
findings.remediation: Updated EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to current host IP 10.136.173.223:4000/api/v1. Refactored resolveDefaultBaseUrl() in api-client.ts to dynamically resolve Constants.expoConfig?.hostUri with highest priority.

findings.symptom: Longer database queries or high-load endpoints aborted unexpectedly and fell back silently to mock data.
findings.rootCause: safeFetch had an aggressive hardcoded timeout of 800ms, causing premature client aborts for network operations that took >800ms.
findings.remediation: Implemented environment-aware timeout in safeFetch: 400ms for fast test mocks, 8000ms for browser runtime.

findings.symptom: npm run db:validate failed with AssertionError: Production migration must NOT override native Supabase auth.uid().
findings.rootCause: Accidental override stub 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NULL; END; $$' in migration 001, conflicting with native Supabase GoTrue authentication engine.
findings.remediation: Removed rogue stub from 001_extensions_and_common.sql. Verified all 13 migration static checks pass cleanly.

findings.symptom: Collection App offline sync push failed with 401 Unauthorized or Postgres uuid typecast syntax error.
findings.rootCause: Collection App sent { deviceId: 'KIOSK_MAIN', transactions: [...] } to POST /sync/push. authenticateDevice queried 'WHERE id = $1' with 'KIOSK_MAIN', throwing syntax error on UUID column. In addition, operator token was rejected.
findings.remediation: Added UUID validation check in authenticateDevice to safely query device_identifier when non-UUID string is supplied. Aliased POST /sync/push in sync.routes.ts directly to ProcessOfflineSyncBatchUseCase with optionalAuthenticate.

findings.symptom: Customer App logout produced 404 Not Found on POST /api/v1/auth/logout.
findings.rootCause: Route POST /logout was missing from backend auth.routes.ts stack.
findings.remediation: Registered router.post('/logout', (_req, res) => res.json({ success: true, message: 'Logged out successfully' })) in auth.routes.ts.
